description_en: Queries the automatic frequency control configuration for a site
description_zh: 查询站点智能限频阈值
name: GetAutomaticFrequencyControlConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version of the site. If versioning is enabled, use this parameter to specify the site version. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version
